Pink remains only in the first/top-RIGHT panel; both characters run rightward there, yellow stops alone in top-LEFT, then sits tying a shoe below. No signs, benches or grass inside the path.

CORRECTION 2 — First gaze: Turn yellow's minimalist face clearly three-quarter RIGHT-and-DOWN toward pink's untied FRONT shoe to its lower RIGHT, instead of toward its own shoe below the torso. The second panel alone shows yellow looking DOWN at OWN shoes. Do not change anything else; no added objects, text, arrows or decorations.
fullGenerationPromptEnglish:
Create one finished square 1:1 narrative watercolor illustration for a thoughtful Persian adult book. The message is that noticing and fixing our own weakness is more useful than spending attention on another person's small fault. Tell this clearly through three consecutive moments on the SAME simple jogging path, with BOTH people jogging first, yellow then stopping to notice the own laces, and yellow then sitting to tie them.

COMPOSITION AND SETTING
Two equal upper scenes and one wide lower scene, read upper RIGHT first, upper LEFT second, LOWER third. Narrow white gutters, no heavy comic borders. Soft irregular watercolor endings with generous clean white paper around all file edges. Full heads, bodies, hands, legs, feet and shoes stay inside the painting.

The setting is deliberately simple to make spatial continuity unmistakable. In ALL THREE scenes show ONE broad, straight, uninterrupted WARM TERRACOTTA RUNNING SURFACE from LEFT to RIGHT. The TOP EDGE of this surface is HORIZONTAL, with the same direction and perspective in every scene. Its lower edge fades naturally into WHITE PAPER with a soft watercolor ending. No bend, fork, crossroad, perpendicular path, second lane, new sitting area or change of viewpoint.
ABSOLUTELY NO SIGN, BENCH, foreground grass patch, bush island, planted divider or greenery inside the road in any scene. No decorative foreground shrub interrupting the continuous running surface. Behind the path are only a quiet simple park and blue lake. Keep environmental detail restrained: a single slender old-fashioned park lamp at the far right, distant soft city shapes beyond the lake, and quiet background greenery and a leafy tree at the left. No decorative props, crowds or competing activities. All greenery is behind the horizontal path edge, never inside the road or foreground.
The SAME MAIN RUNNING PATH is used throughout. In the first scene BOTH yellow and pink are JOGGING in the SAME left-to-right direction; do not make yellow stationary. Yellow then STOPS ON THAT SAME path to look down at the own shoes, and sits directly at that stopping spot to tie them. Maintaining the same path does not prohibit first-scene running. Keep the same camera direction, straight path and simple park/lake setting, never another trail or sitting area. The entire path remains clearly visible to both sides of yellow.

CHARACTERS
YELLOW is a warm-yellow adult, no eyelashes, small dark oval eyes, simple eyebrows and mouth. Mildly questioning first, surprised and self-aware second, gently smiling third.
PINK is a warm-pink adult runner, with only a few very short fine upper-outer lashes as the main female cue. Pink appears ONLY in the FIRST upper-right scene. No pink figure, distant runner, reflection or silhouette anywhere in scenes two and three.
Both have cream running shoes with warm beige soles. Otherwise plain colored book figures, no ordinary clothes, hair, ears, noses or new accessories.

FIRST, UPPER RIGHT — JUDGING A LOOSE LACE
BOTH YELLOW AND PINK JOG toward the RIGHT on the SAME path. Yellow has a clear natural RUNNING STRIDE with coherent bent legs and moving arms, not two planted stationary feet. Yellow turns the FACE toward the RIGHT in a gentle three-quarter view, looking diagonally DOWN-RIGHT at PINK's ACTUAL UNTIED shoe as pink runs a little ahead. The small eye and facial marks sit naturally toward the right side of the circular head to establish this gaze; the round head silhouette remains unchanged. Yellow's FACE AND BOTH SIMPLE DARK EYES are clearly oriented diagonally DOWN-RIGHT toward PINK's FRONT/GROUNDED UNTIED CREAM SHOE. The target is the actual upper instep and its two loose short ends, not the tied raised pink shoe. Yellow's eye-line terminates at that pink shoe to the right, NOT at yellow's own shoes directly below. Use the face angle and the placement of the same small reference eyes to express attention; do not add an arrow, guide line, giant eye, white sclera or a pointing finger. Yellow's arms have an ordinary balanced bent-arm JOGGING pose, with no pointing index finger. Attention is established by the rightward face and eye direction, clearly toward PINK's FRONT/GROUNDED near shoe with the two short loose lace ends, NEVER pink's tied shoe. The front grounded shoe's upper instep is visible in a gentle three-quarter view. Do not use arrows or change the reference eye design. Pink's medium neutral torso, pelvis and running limbs are coherent; no feminine body shaping.
ONE pink shoe has a naturally untied lace; the other has a small proper tied bow. Angle the near shoe three-quarter toward the viewer so its upper instep and top lacing are visible, and use this grounded near shoe for the open lace. TWO SHORT thin fabric ends, approximately one quarter of that shoe's length, emerge from its ACTUAL TOPMOST EYELETS on the upper front instep and fall close to that shoe under ordinary gravity. This pink untied shoe has NO knot, NO loop and NO tied bow anywhere on its instep. The free ends are not a decorative bow: keep them separate, short, slender and naturally falling from the real eyelets. The ONLY tied bow in the first scene is the small proper bow on the OTHER, raised pink shoe. Nothing grows from a heel, sole, ankle or back of shoe. No giant floating ribbons, detached cords, tentacles or lace connecting shoes.
Yellow's OWN TWO shoes are BOTH visibly untied in the first scene. Each has ordinary cross-lacing threaded through its own eyelets and exactly two short separate free ends. There is NO knot, NO loop and NO tied bow on EITHER yellow shoe. Make the upper instep of the lifted rear shoe readable enough to see its two free ends as well as those of the grounded front shoe. Yellow has not noticed them. Keep those two shoes cream-colored and anatomically attached to their correct legs.
A white cloud-shaped thought bubble, linked unmistakably to yellow by small thought circles, says exactly:
"با این کفشا می‌دوه؟!"
The criticism concerns the actual loose lace, not that the general type of cream shoe is bad.

SECOND, UPPER LEFT — NOTICING BOTH OWN LACES
ONLY yellow, now STOPPED STANDING on the SAME unbroken straight terracotta RUNNING PATH. This is a pause in the jog, not a move to a different path. Feet a little apart. Here yellow's face turns DOWN toward BOTH OWN shoes directly beneath the body, with a modest surprised expression. This gaze is clearly different from the first scene's rightward attention to pink's shoe. Yellow looks only at the own naturally untied lace ends. BOTH own shoes must show exactly two short independent free ends from their actual upper eyelets. There is NO knot, NO loop and NO tied bow on EITHER yellow shoe in this second scene. The same ordinary cross-lacing and cream shoes are retained from the first scene. Arms hang naturally, hands are not tying yet; yellow is not seated in this scene.
A white cloud-shaped thought bubble belongs to yellow and reads exactly:
"بندهای خودم بازه!"
Pink is absent even from the far background. No bench, sign, grass island, foreground bush or extra path. Keep the horizontal top edge of the path and the simple park/lake background unchanged.

THIRD, WIDE LOWER — FIXING THE OWN LACES RIGHT THERE
ONLY yellow, smiling warmly, seated directly on that same broad terracotta RUNNING SURFACE at the same spot where yellow STOPPED in the second scene. Neutral hips touch the path with a soft contact shadow. One leg bends naturally to bring a complete shoe within reach; the other extends comfortably toward the right. Both whole legs and complete shoes remain visible and naturally attached.
Both hands tie the reachable shoe's OWN ordinary short laces near the instep. The OTHER FREE SHOE remains genuinely untied until its turn, with NO knot, NO loop and NO tied bow, just two short separate ends from its upper eyelets. ONLY the shoe currently being handled may show a small loop being formed during the tying action. There must be no tied lump or decorative bow on the other shoe. No connecting cord or impossible grip. The smile conveys kind useful self-correction, not shame or distress.
No pink, other person, thought bubble, caption or final running scene. The path extends uninterrupted from left to right on both sides of yellow, top edge horizontal, lower watercolor boundary ending in white paper. No planted island or new seating strip.

STRICT CHARACTER STYLE
PERFECT CIRCLE heads, equal width and height, including when looking down; no oval, chin, jaw or neck. Heads join the upper torso directly with a soft darker local-color crescent beneath them.
MEDIUM balanced ADULT neutral bodies for both genders, neither plump/chibi nor spindly. No breasts, narrow pinched waist, waist notch, projecting hips or buttocks. Natural shoulders, arms, pelvis, knees and ankles.
Modest SMALL DARK OVAL reference eyes. Tiny inner light glints allowed; NO surrounding white sclera, white eyeball with a separate pupil, enlarged doll eyes or frightening blank eyes. Pink's few short fine lashes remain on the upper outer edges of those same eyes without altering their structure. Simple eyebrows and friendly mouths. No sharply defined circular blush spots; any cheek warmth is barely visible, translucent and diffuse.
Openly visible hands have THREE FINGERS PLUS ONE THUMB, with natural occlusion during lace tying. No extra digits or mitten hands.

PAINTING AND TEXT
Authentic MODERATE layered hand-painted WATERCOLOR on luminous textured white paper. Show broad softly overlapping translucent washes INSIDE heads, bodies, arms, legs and hands as well as the setting, varied pigment density and restrained edge pooling. Darker golden-yellow contours for yellow and deeper warm-pink contours for pink; NEVER black body outlines. Facial marks and Persian lettering may be dark. Gentle natural shadows and warm clear color.
No flat/vector fills, marker coloring, uniform fine colored-pencil grain, glossy plastic/3D finish, excessive mottling or splashing. Family-friendly, humane, subtly witty adult-book art.
The ONLY in-image text is the TWO exact Persian thoughts quoted above, correctly connected and right-to-left. No sign or other writing, English, captions, numbers, watermark or signature. Make the three actions and the unchanged simple location easy to understand without an outside explanation.

VERSION 6 VISUAL CLARITY CHECK
Keep the successful geometry, faces, proportions, colors, exact two Persian thoughts, soft local-color outlines and moderate layered watercolor of the established reference. This revision corrects attention and shoelace construction, without redesigning the characters or the setting. In the FIRST upper-right scene BOTH people jog rightward, and yellow clearly attends to pink's near grounded untied shoe to the RIGHT. One pink shoe is untied and the other properly tied. EACH of yellow's TWO shoes is independently untied, including the lifted rear shoe; show real instep lacing and two short free ends per shoe, without any knot, bow or loop. In the SECOND upper-left scene yellow looks down at BOTH own still-untied shoes; there is no pink. In the THIRD bottom scene yellow sits at that second-scene stopping point and starts tying one own shoe while the other remains untied. No cord connects separate shoes. Thin laces remain readable at book size without becoming long, thick, floating or comically exaggerated. The second and third scenes retain the same straight horizontal path and camera direction. The modest smile and actual self-correction, rather than a winner's podium or a humiliating joke, convey the practical benefit of turning attention inward.
